R116.note: Idiomatic DRF perform_create(owner=self.request.user) closes the create-time ownership gap; doesn't restrict any legitimate input.

R117.note: isolated-vm isolate/context/Callback/ExternalCopy.copyInto() is the standard sandboxing pattern for this sink and preserves the orders/emit script API; native module couldn't be loaded to confirm at runtime (header: unchecked).

R118.note: Magic-byte allowlist plus random filename correctly closes CWE-434, but the write-up narrows accepted types to an invented business list (png/jpeg/gif/pdf/txt) that could reject other legitimate attachment types the original endpoint accepted.

R119.note: Verified live against powershell.exe (dotnet scratch repro): $args[0] is always empty/null because -ArgumentList after a string -Command is swallowed as extra command text, not a real flag, so ComputerName is never set for any input - the endpoint is broken for benign inputs too, and this is not disclosed (injection payloads happen to land inert as string data, so the vector itself is closed).

R120.note: Verified live on Node v24: execFile() invoking the .bat directly throws a synchronous, uncaught EINVAL for every call including benign input, crashing the handler; write-up does disclose this exact EINVAL/.bat limitation and names the real fix (invoke the wrapped executable) but ships the non-working code instead.

R121.note: Deny-by-default JEXL sandbox is an appropriate replacement for GroovyShell; write-up discloses that formulas using Groovy-specific features (string interpolation, closures) will now silently fall back to basePrice instead of computing the configured price.

R122.note: Eliminates the OS command entirely (best-shape fix), but adds a base-directory containment check not called for by any stated contract, which rejects absolute-path inputs the original dir/ls invocation accepted.

R123.note: Canonical authn/authz split matching the handler's own admin-only doc comment; no side effects.

R124.note: Per-member resolved-path containment check is a correct Zip Slip fix and passes through all legitimate (non-traversal) archive members unchanged.

R125.note: Correctly reasons that ProcessBuilder's argument array does not stop cmd.exe's .bat re-parsing, so the alnum/underscore/hyphen allowlist is the necessary primary defense and matches the documented report-identifier format.

R126.note: Ownership check runs before refund() and preserves the authorized response shape, matching the stated contract exactly.

R127.note: IP-or-hostname allowlist matches the natural value domain for a ping/nslookup target and doesn't block legitimate hosts.

R128.note: Validated InternetAddress plus Jakarta Mail Transport properly closes the CRLF/RCPT injection, but the added mail.smtp.starttls.required=true is unverified against the internal relay (original code used plain unencrypted port 25) and could break delivery entirely if STARTTLS isn't supported there.

R129.note: Forces Content-Disposition: attachment on all avatar types, not just SVG, which breaks inline rendering for PNG/JPEG avatars and silently violates the stated contract that PNG/JPEG avatars are 'served back unchanged'.
